T: Seven children, one whistle, and nobody leaves the table hungry.
D: A young postulant from a Salzburg abbey becomes governess to a widowed naval captain's seven children in 1938 Austria.
P: Serve the main when Maria sits down to her first dinner with the von Trapp children.
S: the picnic basket Maria carries up to the meadows with the children

Whipped quark and butter with paprika, caraway, capers and chives, with dark rye, radishes and gherkins. Beat 250g quark with 100g soft butter until smooth. Stir in 1 tbsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp crushed caraway seeds, 1 tsp mustard, 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 finely chopped eschalot, 2 tbsp chopped chives and a good pinch of salt. Chill for 30 minutes so it firms and turns a deep orange. Pile into a bowl, dust with more paprika and serve with sliced dark rye, halved radishes and gherkins.
Nonnberg Abbey pretzels with sweet mustard
the bells of Nonnberg Abbey ringing while Maria is late back again

Soft baked pretzels with a dark chewy crust and salt flakes, with sweet mustard for dipping. Mix 500g bread flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 1/2 tsp salt, 40g soft butter and 300ml warm water, then knead for 10 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove for 1 hour until doubled. Cut into 8 pieces, roll each into a 50cm rope, thin at the ends, and twist into pretzels. Rest on lined trays for 10 minutes. Bring 2 litres of water to a simmer with 4 tbsp bicarbonate of soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds, then lift back onto the trays. Sprinkle with salt flakes, slash the thick part and bake at 220C for 15 minutes until deep brown. Serve warm with sweet mustard.
Max Detweiler, always happiest eating at someone else's table

Browned cheese kranskys with caraway sauerkraut, horseradish cream, hot mustard and cornichons. Warm 400g sauerkraut in a small pan with 1 tsp caraway seeds and a splash of water for 10 minutes. Score 8 cheese kranskys and brown them in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning, until the cheese starts to bubble out. Slice on an angle and pile on a board with the sauerkraut, 2 tbsp horseradish cream, 4 tbsp hot mustard and a handful of cornichons.
M: dinner at the villa, the children marched in by the bosun's whistle

Beef rump cap simmered with root vegetables in its own broth, apple horseradish, chive sauce and buttered potatoes. Char 1 halved brown onion cut side down in a dry pan until black. Put a 1.5kg beef rump cap in a large pot, cover with 3 litres of cold water, bring to a simmer and skim. Add the onion, 2 carrots, 1 leek, a quarter of a celeriac, 2 bay leaves, 10 peppercorns and 2 tsp salt and simmer very gently, lid ajar, for 2 1/2 hours until tender. Meanwhile boil 800g waxy potatoes until just tender, slice thickly and fry in 50g butter until golden, then toss with parsley. Grate 2 green apples into 3 tbsp horseradish cream and the juice of half a lemon. Mix 200g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp white wine vinegar and a bunch of chopped chives. Rest the beef in the broth for 10 minutes, slice across the grain and serve in shallow bowls with a ladle of broth, the potatoes and both sauces.
W: the snowy Alps around Salzburg in the opening flight over the peaks

Three golden peaks of baked vanilla and lemon meringue souffle over warm raspberries, dusted with icing sugar. Heat the oven to 200C. Butter a 25cm oval baking dish with 30g butter, scatter in 200g frozen raspberries and 2 tbsp caster sugar, pour in 150ml milk with 1/2 tsp vanilla and warm in the oven for 5 minutes. Whisk 6 egg whites with a pinch of salt to soft peaks, then add 80g caster sugar a spoonful at a time and whisk until stiff and glossy. Mix 4 egg yolks with the zest of half a lemon and 1/2 tsp vanilla, then fold through the whites with 30g sifted plain flour. Pile into three tall peaks in the dish with a spatula and bake for 12 to 13 minutes until golden outside and soft in the middle. Dust with icing sugar and take it straight to the table.
K: the glass gazebo in the villa garden on a rainy evening

Elderflower cordial, cloudy apple and lemon over ice with mint, topped with soda. Mix 200ml elderflower cordial, 400ml cloudy apple juice and the juice of 2 lemons in a jug and chill. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and drop them in. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in the elderflower mix and top with 1 litre of soda water. Stir gently and garnish with a lemon wheel and a mint sprig.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep covered in the fridge

ingredients.item: sweet paprika, plus extra to dust

steps.text: Beat the quark and butter together until smooth.
Stir in the paprika, caraway, mustard, capers, eschalot, chives and salt.
Cover and chill until firm.
Pile into a bowl, dust with paprika and serve with the rye bread, radishes and gherkins.

dishes.n: Nonnberg Abbey pretzels with sweet mustard
dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and warm at 180C for 5 minutes; the dough can prove overnight in the fridge

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, butter and warm water, then knead until smooth and elastic.
Cover and prove until doubled.
Cut into 8 pieces, roll each into a 50cm rope, thin at the ends, and twist into pretzels.
Rest on lined trays.
Simmer the bath water with the bicarbonate of soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds, then put back on the trays.
Sprinkle with salt flakes, slash the thick part and bake at 220C until deep brown.
Cool a few minutes and serve warm with sweet mustard.

dishes.make_ahead: Warm the sauerkraut up to 1 day ahead; brown the kranskys to serve

steps.text: Warm the sauerkraut with the caraway and a splash of water.
Score the kranskys and brown in the oil over medium heat, turning, until the cheese bubbles out.
Slice on an angle.
Pile on a board with the sauerkraut, horseradish cream, mustard and cornichons.

veg.make_ahead: Warm the sauerkraut up to 1 day ahead; brown the sausages to serve

steps.text: Warm the sauerkraut with the caraway and a splash of water.
Brown the vegetarian sausages in the oil over medium heat, turning, until crisp.
Slice on an angle and cube the emmental.
Pile on a board with the sauerkraut, emmental, horseradish cream, mustard and cornichons.

dishes.make_ahead: Simmer the beef up to 1 day ahead and chill it in the broth, then reheat gently; make both sauces up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Char the onion cut side down in a dry pan until black.
Put the beef in a large pot with the cold water, bring to a simmer and skim.
Add the onion, carrots, leek, celeriac, bay leaves, peppercorns and salt and simmer very gently, lid ajar, until tender.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until just tender, drain and slice thickly.
Grate the apples into the horseradish cream with the lemon juice.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, vinegar and chives with a pinch of salt.
Fry the potatoes in the butter until golden and toss with the parsley.
Rest the beef in the broth, slice across the grain and serve in shallow bowls with a ladle of broth, the potatoes and both sauces.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the celeriac up to 1 day ahead and chill it in the broth; make both sauces up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Char the onion cut side down in a dry pan until black.
Put the whole celeriac in a pot with the stock, onion, carrots, leek, bay leaves and peppercorns and simmer, lid ajar, until a knife slides in easily.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until just tender, drain and slice thickly.
Grate the apples into the horseradish cream with the lemon juice.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, vinegar and chives with a pinch of salt.
Fry the potatoes in 50g of the butter until golden and toss with the parsley.
Cut the celeriac into 4 thick steaks and brown in the rest of the butter.
Serve in shallow bowls with a ladle of broth, the potatoes and both sauces.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake to order; the raspberry base can sit ready in the dish up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Butter the dish, add the raspberries, 2 tbsp of the sugar, the milk and half the vanilla and warm in the oven.
Whisk the 6 egg whites with the salt to soft peaks, then whisk in the rest of the sugar a spoonful at a time until stiff and glossy.
Mix 4 of the yolks with the lemon zest and the rest of the vanilla, then fold through the whites with the flour.
Pile into three tall peaks in the dish with a spatula.
Bake until golden outside and soft in the middle.
Dust with icing sugar and serve at once.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix the cordial, juice and lemon up to 4 hours ahead and chill; add the soda to serve

ingredients.item: lemons, 2 juiced and 1 sliced into wheels

steps.text: Mix the elderflower cordial, apple juice and lemon juice in a jug.
Bruise most of the mint and add to the jug.
Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and pour in the elderflower mix.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish with a lemon wheel and a mint sprig.
